title: Cookie policy
body:
The data controller is Radical Books, Societat Cooperativa Catalana Limitada (Tax ID F10524965), registered at carrer Mestre Serradesanferm, 3, 08032 Barcelona. Contact: info@manifestllibres.cat. Orsini is a project linked to this cooperative.

What are cookies?

They are small identifiers a website can store in your browser. Strictly necessary cookies may be used for operation and security; analytics, personalisation or advertising cookies require prior consent where applicable.

A single consent manager

Orsini is part of the Radical Books website and uses the same consent manager, both at radicalbooks.coop/orsini/ and at orsini.radicalbooks.coop. It does not show a banner of its own. Orsini does not install analytics or advertising tools; if Radical Books activates any, they will only load with your prior consent.

Manage your consent

You can change or withdraw your choice at any time with the “Cookie settings” link in the footer. You can also delete stored data from your browser settings.

Inventory

rb_cookie_consent: a necessary Radical Books cookie that remembers your consent choice for 180 days; it applies to the whole radicalbooks.coop domain. Browser session storage during registration: temporarily keeps the credential used to check the result and is deleted when you close the tab. Stripe may use its own technologies on its payment page. This inventory must be updated before any new service is activated.
